news.title: Australian shares shake off early slump to creep higher
news.snippet: Australia’s sharemarket has ended the day higher after strong performances from mining and energy stocks helped counterbalance broader weakness.

news.title: ASX set to jump as Wall Street rallies; Nvidia tumbles amid ‘Chinese spy’ probe; Oil falls
news.snippet: The stock market is rallying and recovering more of its big loss from last week as oil prices swing lower. The strength came even though Nvidia, one of Wall Street’s most influential stocks, sank.

news.title: Corporate cop investigating $3b collapse of major Sydney builder
news.snippet: Financial advisers are channelling money into a sector that ASIC has accused of being home to some operators that use hidden fees and shift investor cash around.

news.title: TMK smashes Mongolian gas record as 30-year licence beckons
news.snippet: TMK Energy has lifted gas output 11 per cent to a monthly record in Mongolia, as acceptance of its gas discovery declaration opens a path to a 30-year production licence.

news.title: Data centre giant apologises to Melbourne residents, vows to get power to site
news.snippet: NextDC boss Craig Scroggie said he was sorry residents felt they had been left behind by his plans to build a major AI data centre in West Footscray.

news.title: Dalaroo eyes bigger gold prize after fresh African hits
news.snippet: Dalaroo Metals has nailed a 13m zone grading 2.67g/t gold, 1.25km along strike from its recent high-grade discovery in West Africa, opening up a possible new mineralised system.
